ai_summary: Abbott India Limited has filed a routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The accompanying certificate from KFin Technologies Limited confirms the timely and proper processing of dematerialized securities, including their acceptance/rejection, listing, and updating of the Register of Members, with physical certificates duly mutilated and cancelled. This indicates robust and compliant share registry operations, presenting no material impacts or red flags.
